title: crap-score report rows
description: The report <report-dir>/<story-id>.json that crap-score writes on exit 0 or 1: one JSON array, one row per judged function. Exit 2 writes no report (validation-rules.md BR-133).

function.description: As in measure-output-rows.json: the qualified name.

crap_score.description: complexity^2 x (1 - coverage_pct/100)^3 + complexity, rounded to two decimals, half up (BR-131, DEC-36).

pass_fail.description: pass when crap_score is at or below the threshold; accepted when it is above the threshold and at or below the accepted score of a register row on dev that names the file and the function; fail otherwise. accepted counts as a pass (BR-132).

file.description: The code file that the measuring command cannot parse.

parse_error.description: The message of the parser. crap-score fails the row with exit 1 and names the file (DEC-34).

pass_fail.description: A parse error row always fails (DEC-34).
